events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my lorazepam. I've only got two left.
One moment while I check your details.
Lorazepam cannot be requested on this line. Please contact the Cedar Clinic prescription desk on five five five, zero one four two, open weekdays from eight in the morning to six in the evening.
Can't you just send it anyway? It's on my record .
I’m sorry, I can’t send requests for controlled medicines on this line. Please contact the Cedar Clinic prescription desk directly.
